lines.en: I fly low, my wings like a drum.
This body is more than two blocks long.

lines.zh: 我从巢口飞出来，绕着走。
lines.en: I come out of the hive mouth and circle.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面巡，蜂群跟着。
lines.en: I patrol low and the swarm follows.
The wingbeat never stops.

lines.zh: 我绕着花丛转一圈，再往上。
lines.en: I circle the flowers once, then climb.

lines.zh: 我飞得不快，但方向很稳。
lines.en: I'm not fast, but my line is steady.

lines.zh: 我在树间穿过去，枝都被扫开。
lines.en: I pass between trees and branches get swept aside.
I fly the edge of the hive.
The air shakes as I pass.
I hover, wings beating fast.

lines.zh: 我的腹部一节一节在动。
lines.en: My abdomen moves in segments.

lines.zh: 蜂群绕着我，不敢靠太近。
lines.en: The swarm circles me, not daring too close.
I'm reading the smells in the air.
You fill my many eyes.

lines.zh: 我把前肢抬起来理了理触角。
lines.en: I lift a foreleg to groom my antennae.
The hive is warm. Out here it's cool.

lines.zh: 我悬着不动，声音却很大。
lines.en: I hold still, yet I'm loud.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转向，观察这个方向。
lines.en: I turn slowly to study this side.

lines.zh: 我腹部的纹路在光下发亮。
lines.en: My stripes shine in the light.
Pollen settles on my back.

lines.zh: 我不累，我能这样悬一天。
lines.en: I could hover like this all day.

lines.zh: 我的刺收在腹末，还没用。
lines.en: My sting rests at my abdomen's tip. Not yet used.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖翅膀，把灰抖掉。
lines.en: I shake my wings and dust falls off.
The hive's scent comes from behind me.
I'm deciding which side to charge from.
You've entered my territory.

lines.zh: 我低头，复眼全在你身上。
lines.en: I look down, every eye on you.

lines.zh: 翅膀声这么大，你不该装作没听见。
lines.en: The wingbeat is loud. You can't pretend not to hear.

lines.zh: 我打一次，就足够让你记住。
lines.en: One strike is enough to be remembered.
Is that honey in your hand?
I turn slowly above you.

lines.zh: 你的护甲挡不住我的刺。
lines.en: Your armor won't stop my sting.

lines.zh: 我给你最后一次机会离开。
lines.en: Last chance to leave.
My swarm is behind you.
I don't care for being sized up.
You stand firm. It won't help.

lines.zh: 我翅尖扫过去了，你都没动。
lines.en: My wingtip passed and you didn't move.

lines.zh: 我的腹部挨了一下，发麻。
lines.en: Something hit my abdomen, and it's numb.
I wobble but stay aloft.
My wing membranes quiver and I stop midair.
Another mark on my shell.
I rise higher and reassess.
The swarm is agitated.
My hive is below; don't touch it.
My abdomen has gone stiff.
I beat my wings; the sound is rasping.
You strike truer than I expected.
I know the smell of honey.
That thing is sweet to excess.
What you're holding is mine.
I descend slowly and circle you.

lines.zh: 我停在花上，再看你一眼。
lines.en: I settle on a flower and glance at you.
Set it down and I'll spare you once.
My antennae never stopped.
That smell makes me want to go back to the hive.
A little closer to be sure.
Fine. I won't strike.

lines.zh: 你撞在我翅膀边上，歪了。
lines.en: You hit my wing edge and it skewed.
I steady myself and hover again.
My body is heavier than it looks.
You hit the chitin shell.
I pull back half a metre, wingbeat louder.
Don't stand directly beneath me.

lines.zh: 我转了个身，把腹部朝向别处。
lines.en: I turn, pointing my abdomen away.
My legs nearly caught you.
There's dust on my wings.

lines.zh: 再碰，我的翅风就压下来。
lines.en: One more touch and my wings come down on you.
There's only one queen in this hive.

lines.zh: 蜂群围着我，这就是全部。
lines.en: The swarm surrounds me. That's everything.

lines.zh: 你要住进巢里，得先证明自己。
lines.en: To live in the hive you'd have to prove yourself.
I fly high. You'd have to follow.
My sting is only for trespassers.

lines.zh: 同类都在外面忙，别去扰。
lines.en: The others are busy outside. Leave them.

lines.zh: 这片花田，够养活一整群。
lines.en: This field could feed a whole swarm.
I don't say soft things. I tend the hive.

lines.zh: 你要留下，就在门口守着。
lines.en: If you stay, guard the entrance.
When the season turns, we'll speak of other things.
I'll take this pollen back.
I gather it with my legs.
Enough honey here to feed a few larvae.

lines.zh: 我抱起的东西比我还大。
lines.en: What I'm carrying is bigger than me.
So heavy my wings can't lift.
I press it at the hive entrance.
What's on the ground I leave alone.
This carries the smell of soil.
I ferry it back bit by bit.
This much will serve.

lines.zh: 你踩进花田的那一刻，我就来了。
lines.en: The moment you stepped into the field, I came.
The swarm has already closed around you.
I've got you. No mistake.
Wingbeats from three directions.
You've backed to the hive. Worse for you.

lines.zh: 我在你上方，准备第一次冲刺。
lines.en: I'm above you, ready for the first dash.
The swarm passes your tremors to me.
Open ground. Nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 我先绕一圈，再决定从哪面来。
lines.en: I'll circle once before choosing a side.
You've raised a weapon. I know.
We'll start on your right.
I'm in no hurry. I have the whole sky.

lines.zh: 你身上有花粉的味道，很好追踪。
lines.en: You carry pollen scent. Easy to track.

lines.zh: 我的复眼能看见你的每个动作。
lines.en: My eyes see every motion you make.
Good. I've marked you.
One foot back from you, one forward from me.
I won't hold back in this.
Coming from above is fastest.
Your knees won't stop trembling.

lines.zh: 那就开始吧，进我的花田。
lines.en: Then begin. Step into my field.
I drop my altitude.

lines.zh: 我在你左上方，一直跟着。
lines.en: I'm above and left, following.
Your eyes can't keep up with me.

lines.zh: 我绕到背面，翅声还在前面。
lines.en: I'm behind you, but the wingbeat stays ahead.

lines.zh: 我的翅声在前面，人在后面。
lines.en: My wings hum ahead; I am behind.

lines.zh: 你抬手那一下，我就移了位。
lines.en: You raised your hand, and I moved.
That tree blocks you. Good.

lines.zh: 我贴着地面滑，很难看见。
lines.en: I skim the ground where I'm hard to see.

lines.zh: 我停在蜂巢上面，等你过来。
lines.en: I wait above the hive for you to come.
The more you run, the nearer the swarm.
I make no sound but my wings.

lines.zh: 你的脚步在地上，我在空中。
lines.en: You're bound to the ground. I'm not.
I close another half metre.

lines.zh: 你的武器转不过来这个角度。
lines.en: Your weapon can't turn to this angle.
I'm waiting for you to lower your arm.
Every flower here knows me.

lines.zh: 我从你背后过了一次，你没察觉。
lines.en: I passed behind you once. You didn't notice.
My stinger is already aimed at you.
My shadow sweeps across.
Right. Position set.
I dash straight into you.

lines.zh: 这一下带着整身的冲力。
lines.en: That carried my whole body's momentum.

lines.zh: 我的刺尖擦过你的护甲。
lines.en: My stinger grazes your armor.
I'm knocked back and rebalance.

lines.zh: 我从侧面掠过去，腿扫到你。
lines.en: I sweep past and my legs catch you.
Your pauldron's knocked askew.
A short dash, then another.

lines.zh: 这一下不重，但我还没停。
lines.en: Not heavy, but I'm not finished.
You blocked it, and your hands went numb.

lines.zh: 蜂群跟着我一起压上来。
lines.en: The swarm presses in behind me.

lines.zh: 你退到花丛里，那更动不了。
lines.en: You've backed into the flowers. Worse for movement.
This time I use the sting.
My dashes are getting shorter.
One more and it's done.

lines.zh: 蜂巢震了一下，我出来了。
lines.en: The hive shudders and I come out.

lines.zh: 我从巢口挤出来，翅膀还没张开。
lines.en: I squeeze from the entrance, wings still folded.

lines.zh: 蜂群立刻散开给我让路。
lines.en: The swarm parts at once to let me through.

lines.zh: 我的翅声第一次响起来。
lines.en: My wingbeat sounds for the first time.

lines.zh: 这片花田的气味扑面而来。
lines.en: The smell of the field hits me.

lines.zh: 我悬在巢口上方，看着四野。
lines.en: I hover above the entrance and survey all around.
My body is wider than the hive mouth.
I land and the ground jolts.
My abdomen is still pulsing.
The light out here is sharp.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖，翅上的蛹膜掉了。
lines.en: I shake off the pupal film on my wings.

lines.zh: 我在巢前的空地上转了一圈。
lines.en: I circle the clearing before the hive.

lines.zh: 这一片，从今天起归我守。
lines.en: From today, I keep this ground.

lines.zh: 我抬高，又低下去，试着翅。
lines.en: I rise and dip to test my wings.

lines.zh: 花、树、巢，都在原来的位置。
lines.en: Flowers, trees, hive — all where they were.

lines.zh: 我把触角伸开，闻了一遍。
lines.en: I spread my antennae and sniff it all.

lines.zh: 我的影子落在花上，很宽。
lines.en: My shadow falls broad on the flowers.

lines.zh: 有东西进来了，我闻得到。
lines.en: Something has come in. I can smell it.
First a circuit of the hive, then I'll look.
Right. I'm out.

lines.zh: 火燎到我的翅膀，焦了一片。
lines.en: Fire catches my wing and singes it.
I drop and crash into the flowers.
Wings soaked, I can't lift.

lines.zh: 爆风把我掀翻，翅膀乱了。
lines.en: The blast rolls me over and my wings tangle.
An arrow tears my wing.

lines.zh: 那力量让我的翅停了一瞬。
lines.en: That force stops my wings for an instant.

lines.zh: 花都过了季，我没蜜可吃。
lines.en: The flowers are past season. No nectar.
Lightning falls and my wings lock.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有空气，我撑不起身子。
lines.en: No air in the void. I can't hold myself up.
